tests.name: sample-exact ordered gates, sample-clock tempo and block boundaries
fractional dotted periods never accumulate rounded-step drift
down, up/down without duplicate endpoints, played order and octave expansion
random is deterministic and bounded; high notes never exceed MIDI127
MIDI device/channel duplicate ownership, repeated on/off and source disconnect
sustain is source scoped; generated gates never receive a held sustain
HOLD ADD / REPLACE latch inputs, not generated output gates; reset and PANIC clear them
enable/disable transfers held keys, preserves bend/CC1, and tempo edits preserve phase
disabled arp is sample-identical to the working rollback across rates and wet eight-voice chords
actual audio is block-partition invariant, nonzero, bounded, and PANIC recovers
60-second rapid poly/mono/unison arp remains bounded and controller-safe
